verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying:
verses.2: I spoke to the children of Israel and said to them, “When you enter the land that I give you, then let the land be holy to Jehovah.”
verses.3: In six years, you will sow your fields; in six years, you will harvest your crops. You have gathered your produce.
verses.4: And in the seventh year, it shall be a Sabbath for the land. It shall be a Sabbath to the LORD. Your fields shall not be plowed, and your vineyards shall not be harvested.
verses.5: Do not cut down your grain, and do not destroy your barley. Let its Sabbath year be a time of rest for the land.
verses.6: And the land will become your food for you, for your servants, for your livestock, and for the foreigners who live among you.
verses.7: And your flesh and your life, which are in your land, will be a source of food for all who come there.
verses.8: And I have told you that there are seven Sabbaths in seven years. In those seven Sabbaths, there will be forty-two years in total.
verses.9: And you shall bring out a bird as an offering in the fifteenth day of the month, on the twentieth day of the month. On that day, you shall bring out a bird as an offering throughout all your lands.
verses.10: And you shall sanctify the year of fifty years. You shall call it “The Year of Judgment.” It will be a time when every person living on this earth will return to their own homes. One will go back to his own house, and one will go back to his own family.
verses.11: Yovel is the year of fifty years. In that year, you shall not sow seeds, nor shall you cut down its vines or prune its branches.
verses.12: For Yewel is holy; it shall be a portion for you from the field. You may eat its fruit.
verses.13: In that year of Jubile, each person shall return to his own place.
verses.14: And if you are sold to your neighbor by your neighbor, or if you buy from your neighbor, then no one shall give his brother anything in exchange for it.
verses.15: After a few years, you will be able to buy it from your neighbor at a price equal to two times the cost.
verses.16: According to most years, its value increases with time. But according to fewer years, its value decreases. This is because its value is determined by the number of times it’s been used.
verses.17: And do not harm one’s neighbor. And fear Me, your God, for I am the LORD your God.
verses.18: And you shall keep my laws and decrees. You shall carry out them, and then you shall settle down on the earth in peace.
verses.19: And the land was given its produce; and they ate until they were full. Then they sat down safely on it.
verses.20: And if you say, “What will we eat in the seventh year? We haven’t sown or harvested anything yet.”
verses.21: And I commanded my blessing for you in the sixth year. And you did the preparations for the three years ahead.
verses.22: And you shall sow the eighth year, and you shall eat from it until the ninth year comes. Then you shall eat from it again until it is ready to be harvested.
verses.23: And the land shall not be sold to foreigners, for I am the Lord who owns this land. You are my people, and you shall dwell here with me.
verses.24: And in all the land that belongs to you, you shall give it to the earth.
verses.25: When your brother died, and he sold his property, then the angel came to him and saved him from having to sell his brother’s property.
verses.26: And a man who does not have someone to save him; who does not have anyone to help him in his efforts to be saved.
verses.27: And he shall calculate the two items that were sold, and return the money to the man who bought them. Then it will be returned to its rightful owner.
verses.28: And if his hand does not find her, then she shall be sold by the seller’s hand until the year of Jubilee comes. Then she will be released and returned to her owner.
verses.29: And a man who sells a house in a city that is full of people, and whose house becomes dilapidated after several years since it was sold, his house will still be dilapidated.
verses.30: And if he does not get saved by the time that a full year has passed, and if the house in which he lives in that city is destroyed, then it will not be able to be rebuilt for him.
verses.31: And in those gardens that have no surrounding walls or fences around them, on the land itself, their fertility will be measured. And in the river, they will be brought forth.
verses.32: And the cities of the Levites will become cities under their control. They will be a source of prosperity for the Levites.
verses.33: And he will be rescued from the nations, and he will come out of the prison house. His city will be taken from him in the river. For among the cities of the nations, it belongs to them within the children of Israel.
verses.34: And their cities shall not be sold, for they are a possession of eternity.
verses.35: And may your brother be with you, and may his hand be strong with you. May he become a strong partner and companion in life with you.
verses.36: Do not take anything from him; do not harm him. Fear your God and live with your brother.
verses.37: Do not give him your money as a gift; and do not give him anything to eat either.
verses.38: I, Jehovah your God, have brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, so that it may be your God.
verses.39: And when your brother comes to you, and you buy him from his owner, do not work for that owner anymore.
verses.40: When he is hired as a servant, he will remain with you until the age of retirement. He will serve you along with you.
verses.41: And he went away from your presence, along with his children. Then he returned to his family and to the inheritance that belonged to his ancestors.
verses.42: For my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, will not be sold as slaves.
verses.43: Do not fall into it in your weakness, and fear your God.
verses.44: And they will serve you and your truth, which will be with you from among the nations around you. From them, you will obtain servants and faith.
verses.45: And also from the foreign settlers who live with you, you may purchase from them goods and livestock that were born in your land. These people will become your property.
verses.46: And you shall set them aside for your children, so that they may inherit a eternal possession in them. They shall serve there, and among your descendants, the children of Israel, no man shall be inferior to his brother.
verses.47: And when you take Ger’s hand and he becomes your companion, and your brothers also become his companions. Then you can sell him to Ger, so that he becomes your companion, or you can keep him as a property of the family of Ger.
verses.48: After his sale, one of his brothers will be able to save him.
verses.49: May his father or son save us from their family’s harm. May they extend their hands and save us.
verses.50: And he should calculate with his neighbor for the period from the time of his sale until the year of redemption. Then, it will be considered money that has been sold over several years. It will be part of his property during those years.
verses.51: If there are many years before that, then his wealth will be returned to him from the money he acquired.
verses.52: And if, for a while, it remains in those years until the year of redemption comes, then think of it as a time when its glory will be restored.
verses.53: When one leases a year, in that year he will not be able to return it according to your expectations.
verses.54: And if he does not be saved through these things, then in the year of famine, he and his children will also die.
verses.55: For I, the LORD your God, have given you sons who are my servants. They were taken out of the land of Egypt by me. I am the LORD your God.
